author: Unreal Engine
description:
Collaboration and iteration on Unreal Editor for Fortnite (UEFN) projects gets more challenging as teams and roadmaps grow. 

In this session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026, we demonstrate Unreal Revision Control basics as well as recently released branching workflows that provide you and your team more flexibility to plan, iterate, and achieve your vision together. 

We discuss how branching enables safe experimentation, helps teams develop features in parallel, and enables you to plan releases more confidently.

Find out more about using UEFN to develop games here: fortnite.com/developer/tools

title: Building Together: Collaboration & Branching Workflows in UEFN | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026

author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch this video to learn about the debut project from Warsaw-based developer Rebel Wolves and sink your teeth into the reasons Unreal Engine 5 was chosen. 

‘The Blood of Dawnwalker’ is an ambitious open world dark fantasy action RPG set in 14th-century Europe. In it, you play as Coen, a human by day and vampire by night, fighting to save your family in a story shaped by your actions and the secrets you uncover. 
After evaluating their options, Rebel Wolves selected Unreal Engine 5 for key features including World Partition, Lumen, Sequencer, and Blueprints.

Press play to discover how UE5’s tools and workflows helped reduce iteration times and improve collaboration between teams. 

To get the full story, read our interview with Rebel Wolves here: epic.gm/dev-interviews-blood-of-dawnwalker
